seoTitle: Apartment 24, Southpoint, 60 Main Street, Co. Wicklow, A98KF44
description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors welcome you to town centre living at its very best, with apartments built to an impeccably high specifications overseen by Kinsella Interiors with wonderful attention to detail that is rarely seen in apartment living. This superb penthouse apartment presents a rare opportunity to acquire a stylish, low-maintenance home in one of Brays most desirable locations, perfect for young couples or those looking to downsize without compromise. Apartment 24 is set in this luxury block of apartment located in an unrivalled town centre location in the Town Hall Quarter with access from Parnell Road, centred by a private Italian roof garden. Southpoint sets a high standard in architecture, finishes, privacy and security. This penthouse apartment is beautifully appointed having recently been painted and new sumptuous carpeting fitted this wonderful home is ready for immediate occupation. Set at a secure penthouse level with the added bonus of a private balcony, internally this spacious apartment is home to an impressive open plan lounge, dining room and kitchen, two spacious double bedroom, the primary boasting a luxurious ensuite, a superior bathroom in Italian marble with underfloor heating. The kitchen features a high quality fully integrated German kitchen with appliances included. The apartment includes security alarm and video intercoms to front doors with electronically controlled access and designated underground parking. Sure to appeal to many early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate how special this apartment is, book your appointment today.

Accommodation

Entrance Hallway
Welcoming approach via this bright hallway with hotpress boasting ample linen storage and large walk-in store providing an abundance of storage. 


Open Plan Living Room Dining Room Kitchen
6.1 x 6.9m
This super spacious living space is flooded with natural light and enjoying dual aspect overlooking the Main Street and Parnell Road. This wonderful room is large enough to provide designated kitchen, living and dining areas.


Kitchen
The kitchen area features an excellent range of cream high gloss fitted wall and floor units with built-in oven, hob and extractor fan plus integrated fridge freezer, washer/dryer and dishwasher. Cream tiled floor enhances the kitchen beautifully.


Primary Bedroom 
3 x 3.8m
Sumptuous primary bedroom boast excellent storage provided by a bank of built in wardrobes. This room is home to a luxurious ensuite shower room with extensive Italian marble, high quality sanitary includes wc, wash hand basin and shower cubicle with tropical shower head. Under floor heating here also together with a mirror door vanity unit providing useful bathroom storage.


Bedroom No. 2
3.5 x 2.8m
Again this spacious bedroom enjoys the benefit of built in wardrobes.


Bathroom
Wonderful bathroom again with Italian marble tiling and high quality sanitary ware including wc, wash hand basin and bath with shower.




Outside:
The residents of Southpoint benefit from access to a stunning communal Italian roof garden, ideal for socializing with your neighbours or sitting in the sun.
